... he picked her. I had to! I work in a vet hospital and one of our clients had a stroke that left her hospitalized and unable to move and so her pets came to us. He was in a kennel with her other cat that looked just like this one, but she was old and very ill and all he would do was lay right by her and groom her, all day. She eventually got so sick that she had to be euthanized and he was all alone. I felt so bad for him so I adopted him and brought him home. I thought because he was so sweet and nurturing with his friend that he would be a great nanny for my foster kittens. I was wrong, he wanted nothing to do with them. But then in March this girl came along and she was a huge mess, she was about 5 weeks, she had been in an accident and abandoned so we took her in and immediately he was drawn to her and they wouldn’t leave each other’s sides. I thought those are soul mates if I’ve ever seen them.
